data.body: **P2:** This owner-aware continuation path is only used by `WaitForConditionOperation`. `StepOperation` still handles `PENDING → READY` using an ignored `thenRun(() -> executeStepLogic(...))` on the serialized checkpoint batcher. If the configured executor rejects the resumed step, the rejection is lost and the manager can return `PENDING` while the operation is already `READY`, leaving no future state transition to resume it. A submit-and-wait executor can similarly deadlock when the step checkpoints through the batcher that is blocked dispatching it. Route step retry resumption through this coordinator, including retirement of the prior worker before dispatch, and add rejection and synchronous-executor retry tests.
